'''March 2002 Huntsville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Huntsville, AL on 2 March 2002. It is known from Damian Loback's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3421">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-03-huntsville-al-03-02-02d3421/ huntsville-al-03-02-02], DeckTech (Damian "Jamintheeye" Loback, 3 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-03-huntsville-al-03-02-02d3421/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 March 2002
* '''Site:''' Huntsville, AL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
